description: Build a real Excel .xlsx file from data: one or more sheets, each with optional column definitions (header, key, width, numFmt) and rows given as objects or arrays. Bold shaded header, frozen header row and filter buttons (both on by default), column widths fitted to the content, Excel number formats (raw codes like "#,##0.00" or aliases: integer, number, percent, currency, usd, eur, gbp, date, datetime, time, text), strings starting with "=" written as live formulas (=SUM(B2:B9), =B2*C2, cross-sheet refs), ISO date strings written as real dates, and an optional totals row (SUM/AVERAGE/COUNT/MIN/MAX formulas). Up to 50 sheets and 1,000,000 rows per sheet. Formulas are calculated by Excel when the file is opened. Writes to "output" (default "workbook.xlsx" in the output folder) and returns the path and a summary of each sheet.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

parseDates.description: Write ISO date strings as Excel dates (default true).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

autoFilter.description: Add filter buttons to the header (default true).

columns.description: Column definitions. Default: keys of the object rows, or the first array row as headers.

key.description: Property name in object rows (default: the header).

numFmt.description: Excel number format, e.g. "#,##0.00", "0%", "yyyy-mm-dd", or an alias: integer, number, percent, currency, usd, eur, gbp, date, datetime, time, text.

width.description: Column width in characters (default: fitted to the content).

rows.description: Rows as objects (matched to columns by key) or arrays (by position). Strings starting with "=" are written as formulas (e.g. "=B2*C2"); start with "'=" to store literal text. ISO dates ("2026-10-30", "2026-10-30T09:00") become real dates.

totalsRow.description: Add a totals row under the data: true = SUM of every numeric column, or { "<header or key>": "sum"|"average"|"count"|"min"|"max"|"none" }.

title.description: Workbook title (file properties, and the default file name).

name: ai_create_xlsx
title: Create an Excel workbook (.xlsx)
